description: This file contains SQL code defining a PostgreSQL schema for Orleans grain directory, including table creation and functions for grain activation registration, unregistration, lookup, and bulk unregistration, along with SQL inserts for query logging.

methods.name: RegisterGrainActivation
methods.description: Registers or updates a grain activation in the OrleansGrainDirectory table.

methods.name: UnregisterGrainActivation
methods.description: Unregisters a specific grain activation based on cluster, provider, grain, and activation IDs.

methods.name: LookupGrainActivation
methods.description: Looks up grain activation details based on cluster, provider, and grain IDs.

methods.name: UnregisterGrainActivations
methods.description: Unregisters all grain activations in specified silo addresses for a given cluster and provider.
